qualification.criterion: empirical spatial and Fourier convergence checks, not an absolute error bound
qualification.uncertainty_kind: sum of spatial and Fourier acceptance tolerances

qualification.comparison_scope: Sequential processes, four Julia threads and one BLAS thread, same heap/cache settings and qualification criteria. Single observations with recorded warmup.
qualification.compiler_workaround: Julia 1.12.0 through 1.12.4 serialize first row compilation inside its owning worker before releasing the remaining row workers.
